verdict.rationale: New Relic's own docs say you can build and share dashboards, including public live dashboard URLs, and that dashboards offer custom, high-density interactive visualizations powered by NRQL. Nothing in the evidence mentions template variables or defining dashboards as code, and the range of visualization types is never listed. missing for 10: template variables, documented visualization type catalog, dashboards-as-code definition (e.g. Terraform or API dashboard resources), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: Through our UI you can build and share tailored user-friendly charts and visualizations.
Share dashboards with stakeholders outside your New Relic organization via publicly accessible live dashboard URLs
Drive insight with custom, high-density interactive visualizations with a consistent UI.
The same query language that powers New Relic's built-in charts and dashboards is available to you, so you can build the views and alerts your team needs.
